params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Olaf}} throws an axe to the target location that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through, briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them based on distance travelled. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit also have {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|reduced armor}}}} for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: The axe remains in place during the cooldown, and '''Olaf''' can pick up the axe to reduce the {{sti|cd|'''total''' cooldown}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' throws an axe to the target location that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies it passes through and {{tip|slows}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|1 to 3 for 9|400 to 1000|formula=1+(0.25 per 75 units traveled)}} seconds. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit are also inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
params.leveling2: {{st|Monster Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|70+20 to 270+120}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description3: The axe remains in place for a duration equal to ''Undertow's'' cooldown, granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. '''Olaf''' can pick up the axe to reduce ''Undertow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to {{pp|2.5 to 0 for 6|0 to 2.5|type=seconds elapsed since axe landed|formula=2.5 (affected by ability haste) - seconds}}.
params.description4: ''{{tt|Nearby monsters|100 range estimated}} are granted {{tip|ghosting}} for 5 seconds upon Undertow's cast.''
params.target range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|425|Minimum missile range, estimated}}|{{tt|1000|Maximum missile range}}}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|100|Impact additional radius}}|{{tt|250|Axe retrieval radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|300|Axe landing brief sight radius}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Undertow'' may hit additional targets upon landing, but not targets already struck in-flight.
** The axe will land approximately 50 units further than ''Undertow's'' target range if cast below maximum range.
* Projectile-intercepting effects (e.g. {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}}, {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}) cannot destroy the axe, they will instead cause it to stop prematurely and remain on the ground upon collision.
* The timer for how long an axe stays on the ground does not begin until it has landed, thus it is possible to throw another axe before retrieving the first.
* '''Olaf''' cannot pick up an enemy '''Olaf's''' axe on the ground.
{{Effect at cast time end}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Olaf}} gains tremendous {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds, and {{tip|shield|shields}} himself based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}} for a short time.
params.description2: He also grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds for an amount that is capped at {{as|70% '''missing''' health}}.
params.description3: ''Tough It Out {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Olaf's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* ''Tough It Out's'' {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} value is updated when it is cast, even if it was already active.
* At {{as|70% '''missing''' health}}, the health ratio portion of the shield is capped at the equivalent of {{as|{{fd|12.5}}% '''maximum''' health}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Olaf}} consumes {{as|{{sti|health}}}} to strike thunder onto the target enemy, dealing {{as|true damage}}. If this kills the target, '''Olaf''' {{tip|heal|heals}} the {{sti|health|{{as|health cost}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' strikes thunder onto the target enemy, dealing {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}.
params.description2: If ''Reckless Swing'' kills the target, '''Olaf''' {{tip|heals}} himself equal to the {{as|{{sti|health|health cost}}}}.
params.description3: Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.
params.notes:
* The health cost is equal to 40% of ''Reckless Swing's'' {{as|true damage}} value.
* ''Reckless Swing'' can be cast even if '''Olaf''' doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost.
** As with all abilities with health costs, ''Reckless Swing'' will not reduce '''Olaf's''' health below {{as|1|hp}}.
* ''Reckless Swing's'' health refund is considered a {{tip|heal}} therefore it is affected by healing modifiers.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}** '''Olaf''' will also not receive the benefits from killing an enemy if this canceling takes place very shortly before the attack hits the invalidated target, but ''Reckless Swing's'' effect will be consumed.{{bug}}
* The health cost will also be refunded if the target dies shortly after being hit by ''Reckless Swing''.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' becomes enraged for a short time, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself and becoming {{tip|cc-immune}}, as well as gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and increased [[size]]. For a brief moment, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.blurb3: ''Ragnarok's'' duration can be extended by hitting [[basic attack]]s and ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|cc-immune|Cc-immunity|nolink=true}}}}: {{tip|Crowd control}} cannot be applied during this time.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' becomes enraged for 3 seconds, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to them}}, as well as gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and 10% increased [[size]]. For the first second of ''Ragnarok'', he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20|45|70}}%}}
params.description3: ''Ragnarok's'' duration is increased by and up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds for each basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or cast of ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.notes:
* ''Ragnarok'' removes the underlying {{tip|stun}} from {{tip|airborne}} effects, but not the forced displacement, which requires him to use a {{tip|blink}} or {{tip|dash}} ability to override it.
* ''Ragnarok'' does not negate any [[debuff]]s other than {{tip|crowd control}} from being applied unless absolutely necessary.
* The {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} updates dynamically over the duration; Increases or reductions in {{as|attack damage}} after the effect has been applied will still be amplified.
* The {{as|25% attack damage}} scaling amplifies the flat {{as|attack damage '''bonus'''}} as well.
* ''Ragnarok'' will not expire during {{ais|Reckless Swing|Olaf}} cast time.
* ''Ragnarok's'' duration will not be increased if the basic attack is {{tip|dodged}}.
* ''Ragnarok's'' duration will be increased if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
